# Aether Tech Studios

> Aether Tech Studios helps businesses and SMEs grow with conversion-focused design, custom web app development, and end-to-end Zoho integrations.

## Website
- Canonical: https://www.aethertechstudios.com/
- Contact: yagamidev94@gmail.com

## Core Services
- Strategic product and brand design
- Custom web app development
- Zoho implementation and integration
- Workflow automation and business process optimization
- CRM implementation and data flow architecture
- Customer support system setup and service operations optimization
- Security and access-control hardening for business systems

## Zoho Integration Coverage
- Sales & Marketing: CRM, CRM Plus, Marketing Plus, Bigin, Campaigns, Forms, Sign, Social, SalesIQ, Survey, Sites, PageSense, Backstage, Bookings, Webinar, LandingPage, Thrive, Publish
- Finance: Books, Inventory, Invoice, Billing, Expense, Payroll, POS
- Email & Collaboration: Workplace, Mail, Cliq, Calendar, Tables, WorkDrive, Writer, Sheet, Show, Connect, Meeting, Vault, Notebook, TeamInbox, ZeptoMail, Learn, PDF Editor
- Service: Desk, Assist, Site24x7, StatusIQ, Lens, Voice, FSM
- Human Resources: Recruit, People, Workerly
- Developer & Automation: Creator, Analytics, Flow, Catalyst, RPA, QEngine
- Legal and IT Security: Contracts, Endpoint Central, Patch Manager Plus, Remote Access Plus, Identity360, Digital Risk Analyzer, CloudDNS
- Project Delivery: Projects, Sprints, BugTracker, Projects Plus
